text:
zoe-partnerships: Heads up 1: PolarStar (regional HW partner) just declined to accept marketplace POs for TE-EDGE-BUNDLE unless the PO payload includes a notarization reference and an inline cert field. They say their EDI ingest strictly validates an extra segment and rejects otherwise.

sam-procurement: ack. Which segment exactly? can you paste their example?

zoe-partnerships: they shared this snippet for the 850:```
SEG|X-NOTARIZE|REF:NOT-2026-77|CERT:YN
```

vik-ops: we do not emit X-NOTARIZE in our canonical 850. Our pipeline can add vendor-specific segments but needs a vendor mapping entry.

maya-sales: this is blocking two APAC quotes that were supposed to ship this week. customer-facing impact.

sam-procurement: quick options: 1) vendor-mapping + reissue POs (preferred), 2) host cert on secure file server and include a lightweight pointer segment (CERTURL), 3) fallback "CERT_LINE" hack as a PO line.

nina-legal: legal flag: if we add a vendor-specific segment referencing an external notarization file we must add a non-amendment disclaimer and confirm storage controls. Also ask PolarStar if a reference (URL or doc id) is acceptable vs inline cert data.

ops-bot: Automated: PO 2026-12-12-PS-402 created (status: pending).

vik-ops: engineering estimate for mapping + QA is 4 business days; reissue flow needs vendor ack to avoid duplicate processing.

maya-sales: PolarStar's warehouse team says they will not accept separate emails. They want the PO validated on ingest.

zoe-partnerships: I proposed two asks to PolarStar: (A) accept a reissued 850 with X-NOTARIZE segment and a DOCREF token (we'll place notarized doc on our SFTP) or (B) accept a CERTURL segment pointing to our signed object store URL.

sam-procurement: if they accept CERTURL we need to ensure URLs expire and that finance can still match invoices. Also need to avoid invoice matching failures.

nina-legal: I'll draft the non-amendment line and retention requirements. Also confirm cross-border notarization handling for APAC territories.

vik-ops: short-term fallback plan if no vendor ack by EOD tomorrow: add a PO line SKU "CERT-REF" qty=1 with description containing a stable doc id (not full URL) and a reconciliation tag so billing ignores it. Example:```
PO: 2026-12-12-PS-402
LINE: CERT-REF x1
DESC: DOCID:NOT-2026-77
RECONCILE:EXEMPT
```

maya-sales: ugly but workable; customers prefer speed. We'll communicate the workaround in the interim.

ops-bot: Automated: Vendor mapping ticket opened (ID: VM-899) by sam-procurement.

zoe-partnerships: Next steps: sam will confirm VM ticket priority + expected ETA; nina/legal drafts clause; vik will prepare reissue playbook and the temporary PO-line pattern; maya will notify affected customers. If PolarStar declines both options we'll escalate to partnerships leadership for commercial hold.

sam-procurement: VM ticket marked P1, ETA 4 business days. I'll push for expedited vendor signoff.

nina-legal: Drafting clause now 1, will share in thread.

vik-ops: prepping reissue script and reconciliation rule. tagging @oncall-fulfillment.

zoe-partnerships: thanks all. will update once PolarStar responds. Keeping thread for audit and handover.
